'''Ruceba Ahid''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who, along with his accomplices, [[Stu Hemphawar]] and [[Oejoe Hitewa]], worked out of a tiny apartment close to the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Entertainment District]] of Coruscant. Active during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] issued a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] for their arrest, when the group was implicated in trafficking illicit material throughout the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the entire group was eventually hunted down and captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].
